questions.question_text: Provide a detailed summary (80-100 words) of 'The Winner', highlighting the character actions and moral outcome.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Georgia Heard evokes rich sensory details: the visual shift from 'blue dark' to pitch black, the tactile feeling of 'cold grass aching feet', and the acoustic rhythm of breathless panting. She uses personification effectively when tree shadows 'creep close' and 'Night wins!'. Instead of a sports team winning, Night personified as an unstoppable competitor halts play, showing nature's ultimate control.

questions.correct_answer: A) Plays passionately until nature halts the match.

questions.question_text: Extract Question: Based on the passage from 'The Winner', answer: Who wins the game at the end?
Guided Writing Extension: Write a dialogue between a parent and child explaining why the child came home late after play.
questions.marking_scheme_answer:
Format: Dialogue Script. Key Value Points: Running fast by the creek, Losing track of time, Returning when night fell.
Sample Output: Parent: Why are you so late?
Child: We were running so fast by the creek that I couldn't catch my breath! We only stopped when Night won and made it dark!
